channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Former Norfolk quarry could be turned into an alpaca farm
item.description: A former quarry is set to become an alpaca farm, with a former office turned into a worker's home.

item.title: Council allows tenants to use medical cannabis... but won't say how it'll monitor it
item.description: Norwich City Council officials have announced they do recognise the right of people living in its properties to use the drug when medically prescribed.

item.title: OPINION: Prime Minister steps back from the brink
item.description: In his opinion column this week, Paul Geater says this week left him thinking an imminent battle for a new Prime Minister was on the cards.

item.title: Man left with thousands of pounds worth of damage after van crashes into wall
item.description: A man has to repair £3,500 worth of damage after a van crashed into his wall on Hercules Road in Hellesdon.

item.title: Dog attack in Norfolk pub's beer garden remains under police investigation
item.description: A police probe that was launched after a dog attack in the Poacher's Pocket beer garden in Walcott continues more than a month later.

item.title: New electronic warfare jet to touch down at RAF base
item.description: An aircraft built for electronic warfare by the United States Air force is set to visit RAF Mildenhall for the first time.

item.title: The athlete and the artist: Two sides of the same story
item.description: There is something uniquely uplifting about the start of a Winter Olympics.

item.title: Town's first winter beer festival is hailed a resounding success
item.description: Organisers behind the popular Bungay Beer and Music Festival returned to town with a new winter version of the event.

item.title: Decision on discount store in Norfolk's 'poshest' town set to be made within WEEKS
item.description: Lidl's bid to build a new store off Nightjar Road in Holt is "on track" to be discussed at North Norfolk District Council (NNDC) next month.

item.title: A47 to close in both directions for SIX MILES this weekend
item.description: The A47 will be shut between the Fox Lane junction and Easton Roundabout from 8pm on February 13 to 6am on February 16.
